name: web-dark-interactive-calendar-grid-with-count-badges-and-view-toggle
title: Dark month calendar with rounded date tiles, round count badges, weekday pills, a two-tone year title and a view toggle
whatItIs: A black interface with a small dropdown label, a heading 'LN 2024' in white and grey, a segmented toggle between columns and grid views, a row of grey weekday pills and a grid of dark rounded date tiles where some carry small grey circular badges with counts and one date (1) is highlighted in a lighter circle.
whatItMeans: Sleek and tactile; soft tiles and tiny badges turn a calendar into a set of pressable cards.
techniques: Render days as soft rounded tiles.
Show event counts as small round badges.

vocabulary.definition: A rounded square representing one day.
A small circle showing the number of events.
